name: ai-news-reporter
description: Collects the latest AI news via Tavily, removes duplicates, and writes a summarized news report.
author: Ephigma

credentials.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
credentials.description: News search key. Get one free at https://tavily.com

tools.name: search_ai_news
tools.description: Search recent AI news and return a deduplicated list of articles (title, url, source snippet, date). No LLM is used.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Comma-separated search topics. Default: general AI topics.

parameters.name: time_range
parameters.description: day, week or month. Default: week.

tools.name: ai_news_report
tools.description: Collect recent AI news, remove duplicates and write a markdown news report with an executive summary and highlights.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Comma-separated search topics. Default: general AI topics.

parameters.name: time_range
parameters.description: day, week or month. Default: week.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Report language, e.g. English or Japanese. Default: English.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Optional focus, e.g. 'enterprise adoption' or 'open models'.
